topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It welcomes the students, introduces the lecture on cancer evolution, and outlines the core learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: They describe how cell-intrinsic alterations, encompassing both genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications, confer selective growth advantages during cancer evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They explore whether tumors initiate within tissue-specific stem cells or differentiated progenitor cells along normal tissue hierarchies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how microenvironmental cues and inflammatory signals provide the necessary permissive conditions to initiate and sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Tumor Heterogeneity and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the experimental and computational technologies used to profile tumor cell plasticity and spatial interactions within the microenvironment.

topics.label: Integrated Evolutionary Framework of Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes genetic mutations, cellular hierarchies, and microenvironmental factors into a comprehensive model of Darwinian cancer evolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture session and previews the upcoming topic on cancer therapy.
